description: Find relevant published documentation linked from the current GoVisit documentation index. Use it to locate a guide or reference before reading its content. Returns matching document titles and canonical links from that index.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

pagePath.description: Canonical GoVisit page path supplying this tool's published context; no origin, query or fragment.

query.description: Optional documentation title or path text to match.

name: search_documentation
title: Search documentation
